question: Which district had the larger 2025 budget per resident, Stonecairn or Coldharbour, and by how many tenge per resident?

samples.answer:
Stonecairn: \(2{,}884.6\text{ million} \div 14{,}926 = 193{,}164.14\) tenge per resident.

Coldharbour: \(2{,}366.9\text{ million} \div 11{,}407 = 207{,}506.79\) tenge per resident.

Difference: \(207{,}506.79 - 193{,}164.14 = 14{,}342.65\), which rounds to 14,343 tenge per resident.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 14343

Coldharbour: 2,366.9 million ÷ 11,407 = 207,490.13 tenge per resident.  
Difference: 207,490.13 − 193,187.46 = 14,302.67, which rounds to 14,303 tenge per resident.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 14303

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 14268
